user.title: Connect to aisstream.io
user.description: Enter your aisstream.io API key. After this, you'll add your first monitored area (e.g. a harbor) - you can add more areas later without re-entering the key.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured

user.description: Set the area to monitor - pick a location + radius on the map, choose an existing zone, or set a manual bounding box - and/or a list of MMSI numbers. If a location or zone is set it takes precedence over the manual bounding box. Subscribing to the whole world without any filter is not allowed.

data.location: Area: pick a location and radius on the map (e.g. a harbor)
data.zone_entity_id: Area: use an existing zone instead

reconfigure.description: Update this area's location, zone, manual bounding box or tracked MMSI numbers.

data.location: Area: pick a location and radius on the map (e.g. a harbor)
data.zone_entity_id: Area: use an existing zone instead

error.no_filter: Restrict the area (location, zone or bounding box) or specify at least one MMSI number, otherwise every vessel on earth would be tracked
error.zone_not_found: The selected zone could not be found
error.invalid_location: The picked location is missing a latitude/longitude
